acceptance: A dry run never installs a package; a test proves it.
Auto-install prints the exact package and version before installing and is refused non-interactively unless explicitly enabled by the environment variable, with the behaviour documented.
The version string is validated against a package-version pattern before reaching the installer.
platforms install help says it prints instructions only, or the command is renamed with an alias, per the owner's choice.
context:
Source: found on 2026-11-13 while delivering the agent-facing work (PRs BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4202, #4203 and BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site#152, #153, #154). Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.

Owner decision (2026-11-14): non-interactive refusal reuses exit code 6 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_REQUIRED; add no new exit code. For platforms install, change the help text to say it prints instructions; do not rename.

Closeout (2026-11-14): https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/4227 merged (cfeec2d04b). Databricks dry run no longer auto-detects credentials over the network; run-official takes --acknowledge-billable-platform; unguarded paths named in the flag help and docs/operations/run-safety.md. Dry runs never install drivers; auto-install prints package==version and refuses non-interactively (exit 6) unless BENCHBOX_DRIVER_AUTO_INSTALL=1; driver_version must parse as a version (invalid exits 2). platforms install help says it prints instructions. run --help states what each --force value deletes, including the Snowflake and Databricks in-place variants. Open questions are filed separately.
description:
Problem: `--platform-option driver_version=X --platform-option driver_auto_install=true`, or BENCHBOX_DRIVER_AUTO_INSTALL=1, makes ensure_driver_version (benchbox/utils/runtime_env.py) run `uv pip install` or `pip install` for the named version, reachable from run and run --dry-run. MCP cannot set it (allow-list). Separately, `benchbox platforms install` only prints guidance, which its name does not suggest.

Outcome: installing a package is an explicit, visible step, and the dry run installs nothing.
